gate_off.why: the product default: no gate, a complete build output

shell_missing.why: an install whose `npm run build:assets` never ran

iconless.why: not even the png fallback for /favicon.ico

gate_on.why: invitation-only install on a loopback bind

gate_on_secure.why: the same, reachable from the network — cookies gain Secure

redirects.note: The redirect helper is one function; its callers are scattered across api/*.py. The three in static_routes.py are replayed as live cases below — the rest share the helper, so the table is the contract and the require_user flag says which need the auth layer over them.

mimetypes.charset_rule: starlette appends '; charset=utf-8' to media types starting with 'text/'

vectors.why: expiry is exclusive — equal is already dead
